args.body:
Source: Ironbark Tooling newsletter "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain) + companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion).

- Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (article + companion)
